_comment: Host-specific overrides template. Copy to <Hermes home>/data/media-downloader/config.json (gitignored) and edit for this machine. Values below are illustrative placeholders, not real paths. Every key is optional — omit one to fall back to the portable default in config.py, which derives paths from HERMES_HOME / HOME / XDG_CONFIG_HOME / TMPDIR.
_hint: State (archives, cookies, gallery-dl.conf) and this config file default to <Hermes home>/data/media-downloader/ so `hermes backup` includes them. `upload_mode` selects the post-download backend: local (destinations are local paths), rclone (destinations are remote specs like remote:path), or bdpan (pack into an encrypted 7z and upload to Baidu Netdisk under bdpan.remote_dir). The modes are mutually exclusive. bdpan uploads also emit an HMD1 handoff code; on another host, send it to /dl to download, decrypt and import into that host's destinations (local paths or rclone specs, regardless of that host's upload_mode).
_bdpan_hint: bdpan packs each download into one encrypted 7z split into volumes of bdpan.volume_size (7z syntax: 2g, 1g, 500m; empty, "0", "none" or "disabled" keeps a single file). Every volume is uploaded on its own under remote_dir/<archive_stem>/<archive_stem>.7z.NNN, retried bdpan.upload_retries times, so a broken transfer resumes per volume. Outer names are neutral by default (bdpan.obfuscate_filename: true -> <archive_name_prefix>_<YYYYMMDD>_<random hex>.7z) so the netdisk never sees the work title or circle; set obfuscate_filename to false to get the readable slug back.
